verdict.rationale: PagerDuty documents a first-party Status Pages product that gives real-time visibility into operations and incident resolution status and lets users post operational updates from within PagerDuty as the single source of truth. That covers the core of an incident-driven status page. Missing for 10: evidence of custom domain support, subscriber notifications (email/SMS/webhook subscriptions), explicit public/external hosting, automatic sync from incident state, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
